title: Mid-Saskatchewan Pipeline System (Inter Pipeline)
dek: Inter Pipeline's west-central Saskatchewan gathering system: Heavy Blend and Light Sweet crude from the Kindersley and Kerrobert fields to the Enbridge Mainline at Kerrobert. Mid-Saskatchewan Pipeline is Inter Pipeline, not Plains: Plains at the same Kerrobert hub is the separate Manito System, and neither Saskatchewan Gathering System (Kingston's or Husky Midstream's) is this pipeline.
